input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for exception manager, grupo, jogador. Data is persisted through a structured data access layer.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with home functionality, so that I can accomplish my home-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with jogador functionality, so that I can accomplish my jogador-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use grupo capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use jogador capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
